advisor_identified: Historian of chemistry and physics, formerly Horning Professor of the Humanities and Professor of History at Oregon State University.

evidence.says: Oregon State's faculty profile identifies Mary Jo Nye as a historian of chemistry and physics and states that she earned her PhD in History of Science at the University of Wisconsin. She joined Oregon State as Horning Professor and Professor of History in 1994.

The American Chemical Society Division of History of Chemistry biography states that Nye received her PhD in History of Science at the University of Wisconsin in 1970 and subsequently became a professor at Oregon State.

MacTutor's list of Erwin Hiebert's doctoral students names Mary Jo Nye, gives the thesis title Jean Perrin and Molecular Reality, and dates it to 1970 at the University of Wisconsin; its publication entry specifies University of Wisconsin–Madison.
The February 1972 History of Science Society Newsletter, page 6, lists Mary Jo Nye's Jean Perrin and Molecular Reality as a completed dissertation under University of Wisconsin.

notes: The independently documented institution, field, year and dissertation title match linked AHA record 44236. The linked dissertation is hers.
